scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.demo:ready: pnpm run preflight:agency && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test:access-control && pnpm run test:contact-sources && pnpm run test:routing-safety
scripts.evaluate:civic: node scripts/civic-evaluation.mjs && node scripts/civic-demo-check.mjs && node scripts/civic-readiness-report.mjs
scripts.test:routing-safety: pnpm --filter @workspace/scripts run test:ui-translations && pnpm run test:service-evidence && pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server build && node scripts/routing-safety.mjs
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
